summary: Custom EDA credential types define Input and Injector configuration in YAML or JSON and inject secrets as extra vars; activations can attach several cloud, vault and AAP credentials. Avoid extra_vars collisions, never start variable names with EDA_ (reserved), and you need superuser rights to create types or view injectors.
questions: How do I create a custom credential type in Event-Driven Ansible?
Why can't I use an EDA_ prefix in my credential type variables?
Who can view the Injector configuration in EDA?
Can I attach multiple credentials to a rulebook activation?
